findings.finding: Pair-kernel associations differ by scale: 2.5 has high-low contrast +0.631 z (CI 0.495 to 0.758; q=2.19e-5), while 7.0 has -0.485 z (endpoint_effects:13; q=1.46e-4). The supplied 1.5/2.5/3.5 contrasts are positive in all reported batches; this does not establish receptor-contact benefit.

shape_yy is negatively associated with endpoint score grouping (-0.513 z; CI -0.620 to -0.424; q=1.49e-5). Selected regional local_cyy contrasts at regions 0/1/7/16/17 also range from -0.560 to -0.672 z, with no positive batches and q<=1.31e-4; a y-dispersion penalty remains a new causal hypothesis.

Landmark 00 soft_mass enrichment is +0.639 z (q=1.88e-4); later survival enrichment is smaller, +0.365 z (survival_effects:0; CI 0.200 to 0.515; q=0.120; 12/14 independent batches positive). Supplied survival q-values are all >=0.120, so immediate enrichment does not establish corrected-significant survival or future score credit.

Landmark 00 softmin change-rate contrast is -4.914 z (CI -6.855 to -2.616; q=0.0461). Its occupancy3 rate contrast is +4.277 z but q=0.0811 (increment_effects:15), despite positive endpoint occupancy enrichment +0.545 z (endpoint_effects:15; q=2.35e-4). Endpoint occupancy and successful change are distinct observables.

Landmark 06 occupancy5 has negative integrated contrast (-0.365 z; q=6.79e-4) but positive last-minus-first delta (+0.603 z). Its softmin has positive integrated contrast (+0.294 z; endpoint_effects:32; q=6.84e-4) but negative temporal delta (-0.903 z). These summaries caution against assuming a uniform direction across time; they do not locate node-level sign reversals.

The original bound structure supplies 25 ligand heavy atoms, 308 cropped protein heavy atoms, centroid (22.817, -29.983, 14.470) A and covariance eigenvalues (0.111, 5.696, 9.303) A2. Its anisotropy supports a static geometry hypothesis, but provides no affinity labels or evidence that matching it improves generated outcomes.

directions: Compare full, unweighted, static, structure and pocket rewards under matched seeds and the supplied execution protocol; use final predicted target pIC50 as primary and strain as secondary, allowing graph transitions. Select no winner from these observational summaries.

Within the allowed update grids, test contact, repulsion and ligand-anchor weights with controlled comparisons and interaction checks; inspect clashes and receptor distances before treating short pair-kernel enrichment as beneficial contact.

Treat reduced y dispersion and landmark 00 occupancy as geometry hypotheses for prospective validation; retain weak landmark 11/19 endpoint effects as counterevidence against a general occupancy reward.

Obtain empirical node contrasts, support counts and fitted-versus-observed comparisons before testing time_ramp_power 0/1/2. Report distinct/effective ancestor diversity and descendant missingness before interpreting survival or future score credit.
limitations: Evidence is compressed to the strongest eight and weakest two q-values per table; findings describe selected exploratory associations, not a complete enrichment analysis or causal effects.

Survival reports 14 independent batches, but distinct ancestor counts, effective diversity, descendant denominators, missingness and future score-credit contrasts are absent; these cannot be quantified.
No empirical node contrasts, node support or fitted-versus-observed results are supplied. Whole-window contrasts and temporal deltas cannot justify a stage-dependent rule.

Feature definitions, coordinate alignment details and full sample counts are absent; pair kernels cannot be identified as receptor contacts from their names, and axis-specific hypotheses may depend on alignment.

The supplied structure is the original receptor/ligand with no affinity labels. No reward-comparison outcomes or cross-condition contrasts are supplied, so neither a reward winner nor an effect of removing elite_geometry instructions is established.
